title: File inputs
summary: Tools that take files (SEP-2356). Pick an image, PDFs or any file, and the page sends each one as a data URI the server decodes, checks against accept and maxSize, and describes.
about: Tools that take files (SEP-2356). Each file field is a file picker.
The page sends each file as a data URI, and the server decodes it and reports its name, type and size.
upload_image takes one image up to 5 MB, analyze_documents takes several PDFs, and process_any_file takes anything.
The server checks each file's type and size, so try one that breaks the rules.
